title: Which game would you rather play
author: FrontTonight
selftext:
I'm a solo dev and I need to choose one idea and stick with it.

1. Party Simulator

You prepare the perfect party in your apartment: guests, food, drinks, music, decorations, etc. Then everything starts going wrong and you try to save the evening and get the best score.

2. 1970s British Hotel Simulator

You run a small hotel inspired by Fawlty Towers and 'Allo 'Allo!. Guests, staff and visitors are AI-driven, so every evening can turn into unpredictable chaos.

The party game is simpler and more universal.

The hotel has more personality and more possibilities, but I'm worried it's too niche and too big in scope.

Which one has the stronger hook, and which would you personally rather play?

comments.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
comments.body: Useless question without more context about the actual gameplay.

comments.author: Brief_State1126
comments.body: Personally I like the hotel idea. I think it is very niche but that wouldn’t matter if your creating the game for fun but if it’s for monetisation reasons then that changes things I guess

comments.author: LL555LL
comments.body: I'm going to need a lot more details as to what the game is actually involving more than what it's about. One of these sounds more interesting on paper but neither one has any reason for me to personally be hooked but some people might be. If your goal is Mom and decision then it's going to be the party simulator but you'll be probably lining up against 40 others.
